info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Balances-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Balance API allows users to retrieve the current balance of loyalty points for registered hotel members. This API is essential for managing customer relationships by providing insights into loyalty rewards accrued through stays or purchases. Common consumers of this API include hotel management systems and customer-facing applications that enhance user experience by displaying loyalty information. The endpoint supports easy access to loyalty balances, fostering engagement and encouraging repeat business.

get.summary: Retrieve the current balance of points.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch their current points balance associated with their account. Ensure that the user is authenticated to access this information.
